name: Liquity V2
description: Immutable CDP protocol on Ethereum issuing the BOLD stablecoin. Agents can open Troves against WETH, wstETH or rETH at a self-chosen interest rate, adjust or close them, earn BOLD interest + liquidation gains in each branch's Stability Pool, and redeem BOLD for collateral at face value via the CollateralRegistry.

keyFunctions.description: BOLD balance (18 decimals).
Total BOLD supply (18 decimals).

Approve a spender (e.g. a zapper for repay/close, or a DEX). Not needed for BorrowerOperations.repayBold/closeTrove, StabilityPool.provideToSP or CollateralRegistry.redeemCollateral: those burn/move BOLD directly.
Transfer BOLD.
EIP-2612 permit: (owner, spender, value, deadline, v, r, s).
CollateralRegistry address (should return 0xf949982B91C8c61e952B3bA942cbbfaef5386684).
Number of collateral branches (3: index 0 WETH, 1 wstETH, 2 rETH).
Collateral token of branch index.
TroveManager of branch index (use to discover/verify branch contracts).

Redeem BOLD for collateral at face value ($1 of collateral per BOLD, minus fee): (_boldAmount, _maxIterationsPerCollateral, _maxFeePercentage 1e18=100%). Split across branches in proportion to each branch's unbacked debt (debt not covered by its Stability Pool), hitting the lowest-interest-rate Troves first. BOLD is burned from msg.sender; no approve needed. Reverts if the fee exceeds _maxFeePercentage. Use RedemptionHelper if you need a minimum collateral out.
Current redemption fee rate (1e18 = 100%), = decayed baseRate + 0.5% floor. Fee grows with redeemed volume and decays with a 6h half-life.
Fee rate a redemption of the given BOLD amount would pay.
Fee in BOLD for redeeming the given amount now.
Stored base rate (1e18 = 100%).

(_collIndex, _interestRate, _numTrials, _inputRandomSeed) -> (hintId, diff, latestRandomSeed). Samples Troves for one close to where a Trove at _interestRate goes in the branch's SortedTroves. Use numTrials ~ 10-15 * sqrt(number of Troves); then pass hintId as both args to SortedTroves.findInsertPosition to get exact (upperHint, lowerHint).
(_collIndex, _borrowedAmount, _interestRate) -> upfront fee in BOLD (7 days of the branch's average interest rate on the new debt). Use (plus a small margin) as _maxUpfrontFee in openTrove.
(_collIndex, _troveId, _debtIncrease) -> upfront fee for borrowing more; use as _maxUpfrontFee for withdrawBold/adjustTrove.
(_collIndex, _troveId, _newInterestRate) -> upfront fee for an interest-rate change (0 if the last change was 7+ days ago).
(_collIndex, _borrowedAmount, _batchManager) -> upfront fee when opening into a delegated-rate batch.

(_collIndex, _startIdx, _count) -> array of Trove data (id, debt, coll, stake, annualInterestRate, lastDebtUpdateTime, lastInterestRateAdjTime, interestBatchManager, ...). _startIdx >= 0 starts from the highest-rate end of SortedTroves; negative values start from the lowest-rate end (-1 = lowest rate, the next Trove to be redeemed).

(_collIndex, _startId (0 = start at the lowest-rate Trove), _maxIterations) -> per Trove (interestBatchManager, interestRate, debt) walking from the lowest rate upwards, plus the id to continue from. Summing debt below your rate shows how much must be redeemed before your Trove is hit.
(_bold, _maxIterationsPerCollateral) -> per-branch redemption split. Non-view (nonpayable) in the ABI: call it with eth_call, do not send it.
(_bold, _maxIterationsPerCollateral) -> (truncatedBold, feePct, redeemed per branch): the largest amount that can actually be redeemed within the iteration limit. Use with eth_call.
(_bold, _maxIterationsPerCollateral, _maxFeePct, _minCollRedeemed[3] per branch) redemption with slippage protection on collateral out. Approve BOLD to this helper first.

Open a Trove: (_owner, _ownerIndex, _collAmount, _boldAmount, _upperHint, _lowerHint, _annualInterestRate, _maxUpfrontFee, _addManager, _removeManager, _receiver). First approve WETH to BorrowerOperations for collAmount + 0.0375 (collateral and the gas deposit are both WETH). Interest rate 1e18 = 100%, min 0.5% (5e15), max 250%. Debt incl. upfront fee must be >= 2,000 BOLD and ICR >= MCR 110% (and the branch TCR must stay >= CCR 150%). _maxUpfrontFee from HintHelpers.predictOpenTroveUpfrontFee. Hints from HintHelpers.getApproxHint + SortedTroves.findInsertPosition (0,0 works but costs more gas). Managers/receiver can be address(0). Returns troveId = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, _owner, _ownerIndex))); an ERC-721 for it is minted to _owner and BOLD to msg.sender.

(_troveId, _collChange, _isCollIncrease, _boldChange, _isDebtIncrease, _maxUpfrontFee): add/withdraw collateral and borrow/repay in one call. Borrowing more charges an upfront fee (7 days of branch average interest). Resulting ICR must stay >= MCR, debt >= 2,000 BOLD; below CCR (Critical mode) borrowing is only allowed if it lifts TCR above CCR.
(_troveId, _collAmount): add collateral (approve the collateral token first).
(_troveId, _collWithdrawal): withdraw collateral; ICR must stay >= MCR.
(_troveId, _boldAmount, _maxUpfrontFee): borrow more BOLD; upfront fee applies (predictAdjustTroveUpfrontFee).
(_troveId, _boldAmount): repay debt; cannot take debt below 2,000 BOLD (close the Trove instead). No approve needed.

(_troveId, _newAnnualInterestRate, _upperHint, _lowerHint, _maxUpfrontFee): set a new rate (1e18 = 100%). Free once per 7 days; a change within 7 days of the last one pays an upfront fee of 7 days' average interest. Lower rates are redeemed first. Not for Troves in a batch.

(_troveId): repay the entire debt (TroveManager.getLatestTroveData(id).entireDebt, incl. accrued interest) from msg.sender's BOLD and get all collateral plus the 0.0375 WETH gas deposit back. Caller must be owner or remove-manager. Reverts if it would push branch TCR below CCR (unless the branch is shut down).

Adjust a 'zombie' Trove (debt < 2,000 BOLD after redemption): (_troveId, _collChange, _isCollIncrease, _boldChange, _isDebtIncrease, _upperHint, _lowerHint, _maxUpfrontFee). Result must have debt >= 2,000 and ICR >= MCR.
Claim surplus collateral left after your Trove was liquidated or fully redeemed (held in CollSurplusPool).
(_troveId, _newBatchManager, _upperHint, _lowerHint, _maxUpfrontFee): delegate rate management to a registered batch manager (pays its management fee; batched Troves need ICR >= MCR + 10%).
Minimum collateral ratio, 1e18 = 100% (110% on this branch).
Critical collateral ratio for the branch TCR (150%).
True if the branch is shut down (TCR fell below SCR 110% or oracle failure): only closing Troves and urgent redemptions then work.
Total branch debt in BOLD (18 decimals).

Trove state incl. pending interest: (entireDebt, entireColl, redistBoldDebtGain, redistCollGain, accruedInterest, recordedDebt, annualInterestRate, weightedRecordedDebt, accruedBatchManagementFee, lastInterestRateAdjTime). entireDebt is what closeTrove needs.
0 nonExistent, 1 active, 2 closedByOwner, 3 closedByLiquidation, 4 zombie (debt < 2,000 BOLD after redemption; unredeemable until topped up).
(_troveId, _price) -> ICR (1e18 = 100%). Price from PriceFeed.lastGoodPrice(). Liquidatable when ICR < MCR (110%).
Trove's annual rate (1e18 = 100%; batch rate if batched).
Number of Troves in the branch.
Trove id at index (for enumeration).

Permissionless liquidation of Troves with ICR < MCR. Liquidator earns 0.5% of the collateral (capped at 2 units) plus the 0.0375 WETH gas deposit per Trove. Debt is offset by the branch Stability Pool (SP depositors get collateral at a 5% penalty discount) or, if the SP is empty, redistributed to other Troves (up to 10% penalty).
Only after branch shutdown: (_boldAmount, _troveIds, _minCollateral) redeem BOLD from chosen Troves with a 2% collateral bonus and no fee.

(_topUp, _doClaim): deposit BOLD (no approve needed). Earns 75% of the branch's interest (in BOLD) plus WETH from liquidations. _doClaim=true pays out pending BOLD yield and WETH gains; false compounds the yield into the deposit and stashes the WETH.
(_amount, _doClaim): withdraw BOLD (amount above your deposit withdraws all). Pool must keep >= 1 BOLD total. Withdraw with _doClaim=true to also receive gains.
Claim stashed collateral gains; only when you have no deposit left.
Current BOLD deposit after liquidation losses (18 decimals).
Claimable BOLD interest yield incl. not-yet-minted interest.
Pending WETH gain from liquidations (excl. stashed; see stashedColl(address)).

Open a WETH-branch Trove paying in ETH. Struct: (owner, ownerIndex, collAmount (ignored: collateral = msg.value - 0.0375 ETH gas deposit), boldAmount, upperHint, lowerHint, annualInterestRate, batchManager (0x0 unless joining a batch; then rate must be 0), maxUpfrontFee, addManager, removeManager, receiver). msg.value must exceed 0.0375 ETH. The zapper opens the Trove, so troveId = uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(zapper, owner, uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(msg.sender, ownerIndex)))))); read it from the return value. (_troveId, _amount): withdraw collateral as ETH.
(_troveId, _boldAmount): repay via zapper (approve BOLD to zapper).
(_troveId, _boldAmount, _maxUpfrontFee): borrow more via zapper.
(_troveId): pulls entireDebt BOLD from msg.sender (approve first) and returns collateral + 0.0375 gas deposit as ETH. Only for Troves where the zapper is the receiver.
Last valid WETH price in USD (18 decimals) used for ICR; pass to TroveManager.getCurrentICR.
Refreshes and returns (price, oracleFailureDetected). Non-view; use eth_call to read a fresh price. An oracle failure shuts the branch down.
Owner of a Trove (tokenId = troveId). The NFT owner controls the Trove; transferring it transfers the position.

actions.name: open-trove
actions.how: 1) Pick branch (0 WETH, 1 wstETH, 2 rETH) and rate (e.g. 5e16 = 5%). 2) fee = HintHelpers.predictOpenTroveUpfrontFee(idx, bold, rate). 3) (hint,,) = HintHelpers.getApproxHint(idx, rate, 15*sqrt(SortedTroves.getSize()), seed); (upper, lower) = SortedTroves.findInsertPosition(rate, hint, hint). 4) Approve collateral (+0.0375 WETH gas deposit) to BorrowerOperations. 5) BorrowerOperations.openTrove(owner, ownerIndex, coll, bold, upper, lower, rate, fee*1.01, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0). Keep ICR well above MCR (110% WETH, 120% LSTs) and debt >= 2,000 BOLD. Or use WETHZapper/GasCompZapper.openTroveWithRawETH to pay in ETH.

actions.name: adjust-trove
actions.how: BorrowerOperations.adjustTrove(troveId, collChange, isCollIncrease, boldChange, isDebtIncrease, maxUpfrontFee) (fee from HintHelpers.predictAdjustTroveUpfrontFee when borrowing), or addColl / withdrawColl / withdrawBold / repayBold.

actions.name: set-interest-rate
actions.how: Hints as in open-trove for the new rate; fee = HintHelpers.predictAdjustInterestRateUpfrontFee(idx, troveId, newRate) (0 if >= 7 days since last change); BorrowerOperations.adjustTroveInterestRate(troveId, newRate, upper, lower, fee).

actions.name: close-trove
actions.how: debt = TroveManager.getLatestTroveData(troveId).entireDebt; hold that much BOLD (plus a little for interest accrual); BorrowerOperations.closeTrove(troveId).

actions.name: earn-stability-pool
actions.description: Deposit BOLD in a branch Stability Pool
actions.how: StabilityPool.provideToSP(amount, true). Read getCompoundedBoldDeposit / getDepositorYieldGainWithPending / getDepositorCollGain. Exit with withdrawFromSP(amount, true).

actions.name: redeem
actions.how: Check CollateralRegistry.getRedemptionRateForRedeemedAmount(amount); CollateralRegistry.redeemCollateral(amount, maxIterationsPerCollateral (e.g. 50), maxFee 1e18-scaled). For min-out protection use RedemptionHelper.truncateRedemption (eth_call) then redeemCollateral(bold, iters, maxFeePct, minCollPerBranch[3]) after approving BOLD to it.

actions.name: liquidate
actions.how: Find Troves with TroveManager.getCurrentICR(id, PriceFeed.lastGoodPrice()) < MCR; TroveManager.batchLiquidateTroves([ids]).

risks: Redemptions: anyone can redeem BOLD for collateral at $1 (minus a fee of at least 0.5%), starting from the Troves with the LOWEST interest rate in each branch. Redeemed borrowers lose collateral equal to the debt repaid (no net loss at the oracle price, but exposure is lost). Keep your rate competitive; MultiTroveGetter.getDebtPerInterestRateAscending shows the debt in front of you.
Zombie Troves: a redemption that leaves debt < 2,000 BOLD marks the Trove 'zombie' (status 4); it stays open but must be fixed with adjustZombieTrove.

Liquidation when ICR < MCR (110% WETH, 120% wstETH/rETH): the Trove loses its collateral (up to the penalty: 5% via the Stability Pool, up to 10% WETH / 20% LST via redistribution) and the 0.0375 WETH gas deposit. Branch TCR below CCR (150% / 160%) restricts borrowing and collateral withdrawals.
Upfront fee: every new borrow (and rate changes within 7 days of the last one) pays 7 days of the branch average interest rate, added to debt and non-refundable.

Branch shutdown: if a branch's TCR falls below SCR (110% WETH, 120% LSTs) or its oracle fails, that branch freezes (only closing and urgent redemptions at a 2% bonus); BOLD stays redeemable against it.
Stability Pool deposits absorb liquidated debt: the BOLD deposit can shrink and is replaced by collateral bought at a discount; that collateral can fall in value.

Incident and redeployment: on 2025-02-12 the team was told of a Stability Pool issue in the first V2 deployment (BOLD 0xb01dd87B29d187F3E3a4Bf6cdAebfb97F3D9aB98), confirmed 2025-02-13 ('could result in the loss of funds held in these contracts'); users were told to exit and that deployment became legacy. The patched V2 relaunched on Ethereum on 2025-05-19 with new addresses (BOLD 0x6440f144...B01D). Never use the legacy addresses still listed on docs.liquity.org/v2-documentation/technical-resources.
Immutable contracts with no admin keys (no upgrades or parameter changes); governance (LQTY staking) only directs part of the protocol revenue. Oracles: Chainlink-based PriceFeeds per branch.

Audits listed in the docs: ChainSecurity (Aug 2024 - May 2025), Dedaub (Aug and Nov 2024, Cantina-fixes review May 2025), Certora formal verification (Dec 2024), Coinspect (Dec 2024 core, Jan 2025 governance, Oct 2025 RedemptionHelper), Recon (Oct 2024), Cantina competition (Mar-Apr 2025).
